name: Yume Shoujo Sayaka
source:
Main character is tired of spending days alone in the apartment watching beautiful dreams. He goes out to meet beautiful girls in person.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公厌倦了独自在公寓里度日、只在美梦中见到漂亮女孩，于是走出家门，打算在现实中与她们相识。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
